summary: Apply Beztack template v1.2.0 onto Derived project dp_01HMV... (Trusted). Updates the routing harness with the api-route-registration seam preserved, refreshes the Environment contract with WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET, and renders Template parameters into package.json. One Sync conflict (apps/api/middleware.ts) requires an explicit decision. Two ownership overlaps (packages/auth/session.ts, apps/checkout/payment-handler.ts) are reported as warnings and resolved by the more-specific rule. The pnpm-lock.yaml lockfile is preserved as Custom-owned and is regenerated locally by the Derived project's package manager after the apply branch is prepared; engines must not copy a lockfile from the Template source.

conflicts.detail: Template source v1.2.0 introduces a default middleware on a Mixed-ownership path; the Derived project already has its own implementation and no Sync seam is registered for this file. Apply does not silently merge. Resolve by registering a Sync seam, taking the Template version, or skipping the update.
